name: Memory Retention Policy
description: Define retention rules: what is kept, for how long, and when it is evicted or archived. Retention policies can be configured per bank, per scope, or globally.
purpose: Prevent unbounded memory growth and ensure compliance with data governance requirements by defining and enforcing configurable retention policies.
acceptanceCriteria: Retention rules support: keep duration, max count, priority-based eviction
Retention policies can be configured per bank, per scope, and globally
Archived memories are moved to cold storage before eviction
Retention policy changes are logged and auditable
Eviction respects active references and dependency chains
rollback_strategy: Restore previous retention policy; rehydrate evicted memories from archive
recovery_strategy: Rebuild retention schedule from policy configuration; re-run eviction for consistency
